title: Gold catching up with a large crude-oil move it has not followed

rule.signal: oil 10-day log return at or beyond its 10th / 90th percentile of the previous 500, and gold's |10-day log return| at or under the median of its previous 500
rule.entry: gold's next folded UTC daily open, the way of oil's move
rule.exit: close of the hold-th gold candle (entry candle = 1)
rule.baseline: the same side opened at every gold open of the window (same stop, hold and costs), its mean net R
rule.costs: $0.60 a round trip + nights() x FIN.xau.long x entry on longs

tests.what: WTI 10-day move in its top / bottom decile, gold flat: gold the way of oil for 3 days (primary)
the same rule on Brent, 3 days
